findings.detail: The E07 source count of 1603 combines 826 current-period positions with 777 comparative-period positions from the December 31, 2025 schedule.

rationale: E07 is an aggregate count false alarm caused by its source anchor. The filing contains separate complete schedules for March 31, 2026 and December 31, 2025, proven by their terminal total rows at tables 40 and 72. The flagged source count 1603 decomposes exactly into the 826 current-period output positions plus 777 comparative-period positions. Therefore 826 is the correctly period-scoped count and the oracle source count has a comparative-period leak.
